scg.text: Lowallyn, the third numen, appears after Kamahl rescues Ixidor from the deathwurm and Ixidor reemerges as Lowallyn.

Karona annihilates the city of Aphetto while Lowallyn and Kamahl escape through a portal, and Karona later summons five portals seeking her equal, through which Lowallyn comes along with Teferi, Yawgmoth, Fiers and Multani.
Karona encases the Numena in stone, and Lowallyn is freed, only to be stomped to death by his own magma giant under Karona's control.
